answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 15684 Country: AU Title: Assalam valaikum, Is it haram to clean the spilled milk without mixing water. As my husband works in an egyptian store and his owner says that it is haram to clean the spilled milk on floor without mixing water. if it is haran than why? waiting for your reply. Allah hafiz Question: Assalam valaikum, Is it haram to clean the spilled milk without mixing water. As my husband works in an egyptian store and his owner says that it is haram to clean the spilled milk on floor without mixing water. if it is haran than why? waiting for your reply. Allah hafiz Answer ID: 15684 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1454/1381=B=1430) As per the Shariah, your husband is wrong to say so. Spilled milk can be washed without mixing water too. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
